personas.name: completionist mapper
personas.goal: Visit every area, collect all 5 coins, the gems, relics, keys and hearts, open every locked door and finish the level with the correct time bonus.
personas.style: Walks with goto: macros between item clusters, checks the HUD after each pickup, and tracks coins, keys and the score so that the final tally matches the state.

personas.name: sequence-breaker
personas.goal: Reach the exit or other areas early or by unintended routes: dash through gates and locked doors, step onto levers, cross spikes and enemies, and try to finish without the keys.
personas.style: Uses dash-* tokens against walls and closed doors, stands on the lever and presses use repeatedly, and tries to reach the exit before collecting the keys or coins. It keeps a record of every position it reaches.

personas.name: chaos tester
personas.goal: Break the timing of transitions: pause, resume, restart, and quit during pickups, hits, dashes, invulnerability and level completion, with several keys in the same tick.
personas.style: Sends combined tokens such as pause+left, down+right, esc+enter and click:btn-resume in quick succession. Spams input during the dialogs and checks that the frozen timer, dash recharge and toast stay unchanged.

personas.name: literal newcomer
personas.goal: Follow the design document one sentence at a time and check each sentence literally, for example that the start is (1,1), that spikes cost 500 points, that a dash stops before a locked door, and that a heart gives +500 at 5 lives.
personas.style: Works through the document in order, performs one specified action per sentence, and records a pass or fail for each. It avoids improvising and does not skip any section.

personas.name: economy auditor
personas.goal: Push the counters to their limits and check each amount: score at zero after spikes, score near the 999,999 cap, lives at 0 and 5, timer at 1 and 300, dash at 0 and 6, coins at 5 of 5, and the time bonus.
personas.style: Drives repeated spikes and hits to reach zero lives, collects hearts at 5 lives, and waits near the timer limit. After every tick it compares the HUD text (Score, Lives, Keys, Coins n/5, Time, Dash) with the state.

personas.name: photographer
personas.goal: Open every dialog and menu (pause menu, Game over, Level complete, victory) and check what is shown and what can be clicked, including overlaps and hidden buttons.
personas.style: Goes into each mode and reads the UI list. For each visible button it checks the text, the rectangle and whether top is true, then clicks it. It confirms that a click on a hidden or covered button does nothing.

specs.rule: Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999.
At 0 lives the game is over (Game over dialog with Retry), so the game is not playing with 0 lives.
The level has 5 coins; coins collected never exceed 5 and never exceed the total.
The HUD always shows the current score.
The HUD always shows the current lives.
The HUD always shows the current keys.
The HUD shows Coins n/5 with the current coin count.
The dash status shows Dash ready at 0 and Dash n otherwise, where n is the ticks until ready.
The timer starts at 300 and when it reaches 0 the life is lost and the timer resets to 300.
A dash sets the recharge to 6, and it counts down at the end of the running tick, so right after a dash the HUD shows Dash 5.
If the very first tile of a dash is solid the dash does not happen and is not used up.
The player makes at most one move per tick: a step (1 tile) or a dash (up to 2 tiles in a straight line).
specs.expect: abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 2 && (cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y)

specs.rule: Walls are solid: the player never stands on a wall, and a locked door is solid to a dash.
specs.expect: tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '#' && tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != 'D'

specs.rule: A gate is solid while closed and floor while open.
When the game becomes paused, the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing moves that tick.
specs.expect: cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x && cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft

specs.rule: While paused nothing moves; timer, dash recharge and toasts are frozen.
specs.expect: cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.dashCooldown == prev.state.dashCooldown && cur.state.toast == prev.state.toast && cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x && cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y

specs.rule: While playing no dialog is open.
Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.
Restart level puts the level back to its starting state (score 0, 3 lives, all items back) and the game is running again straight away.
Items disappear when collected and never come back except on a restart.
specs.expect: cur.state.coins >= prev.state.coins && cur.state.gems >= prev.state.gems && cur.state.relics >= prev.state.relics

specs.rule: Score only drops by spike damage (500, floored at 0); coins, gems and relics never lower it.
Spikes cost one life and always hurt, even right after a respawn.
Touching an enemy costs one life and no points.
Enemies cannot hurt the player during the tick of reappearing or the next 4 ticks.
After losing a life you reappear at the start (1, 1).
Enemies move one tile at a time, and at most every other tick.
specs.expect: all(cur.state.enemies, e => abs(e.x - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).x) + abs(e.y - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).y) <= 1)

specs.rule: Completing the level adds a time bonus of 10 points per tick left on the timer.
